title: Directed writing: the task and form conventions
subject: English Language

intro: Lesson 31. Decode the task before you write.

panels.title: The task
panels.text: Your school website is publishing a guide for students making their first solo journey. Write an article. You should: explain what can make a first solo journey difficult; give advice on how to prepare and cope; suggest what students can gain from the experience. Use ideas from BOTH texts, in your own words. (30 marks)

checklist: An introduction that hooks the reader
A conclusion that sends the reader off with one clear message
A register that suits students and parents: friendly but not slang

questions.q: Write a headline and a strapline for the guide.
questions.a: For example: 'Going Solo: Your First Journey Without a Grown-Up' / 'How to stay calm, stay safe and come home with a story'.
